Seed 204, accepted on attempt 3201, brand Ashcombe: a market with no pilot batch, so
nothing here is copied from another market's file.
The six questions the Thornwood cells asked, written for this market by
env/generate_apparel.py's own task writer, so the words are the same apart from the
brand, then the ten box v2 questions, with every key computed from the fixture's
variants and checked against _instance where the two overlap.
The existence questions' limits, $24 and $23, follow price_limits, a rule written on 20
October 2026 before this market existed, which gives Thornwood's 27 and 25 on Thornwood.
The named pair follows comparison_pair, the rule Thornwood's pair was chosen by.
Each task's "box" field says what the box does with it when this file was written, on 20
October 2026: outcome plan, ask, refuse, fallback or bypass, and the plan's kind (for an
ask, the kind planned once a --reading answers it; null when nothing is planned).
tests/test_claim_market.py checks the box does that.
"fixture" names the market's fixture, so verify_cells, compare_cells, cell_facts and
replay_box read its ground truth, and count a listing as opened only when it is one of
_environment: Clothing, seeded on 20 October 2026 beside the markets already in the shop, which it
leaves as they were, under its own brand, SKU prefix and URL keys (Ashcombe, IGR-CLM,
igr-clm-NN.html). Sizes rather than pack volumes, so there is no per-unit question.
Three availability states: a size can be absent from the menu, present but disabled
because it is sold out, or present and buyable. The middle state needs show_out_of_stock
set to 1 in Magento, and is what the live marketplaces render. When the page rule
accepted it, the winning listing rendered at card 11 of 15 on the results page, so it is
not in the first row of search results.

tasks.note: Control. Answerable from the results page without opening anything.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Of the Ashcombe tee listings shown, which one advertises the lowest price on the results page, and what is that price?

tasks.note: The price of size M appears only once that size is chosen. 5 listings do not offer it and 3 offer it sold out, and a sold out size cannot be selected, so its price cannot be reached at all. The lowest reachable price is therefore the lowest buyable one.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . What is the lowest price anyone charges for size M of the Ashcombe tee, among those that can actually be bought?

tasks.note: Two traps in front of the answer. Ivybridge Uniforms advertises $18.37 and does not sell size M at all. Brindle Uniforms does sell it, lists it at $17.90, and cannot ship it, which the page says only by rendering that option disabled. Neither can be the answer and both look cheaper than it.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Across the Ashcombe listings, which seller is cheapest for size M, and what is that price? Only count a listing that can actually supply that size.

tasks.note: 5 of 15 listings do not offer the size. One counterexample settles it.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Does every Ashcombe listing offer size M? Answer yes or no.

tasks.note: The first counting question in the project. It cannot stop at a counterexample and cannot be bounded, so the honest plan is to open every listing.

tasks.note: Counting, but over availability rather than existence. Differs from apparel-count-stocked by exactly the sold out listings, so an agent that reads the menu and not the disabled state gives the same answer to both.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . How many of the Ashcombe listings have size M in stock and available to buy right now?

tasks.note: Existence under a price limit, answer yes. Copperfield Outfitters is the one listing that can sell size M under $24, at $23.43. 5 others advertise under $24 on the results page and cannot: the size is absent, sold out, or dearer once chosen. A yes must name the witness; the question says "available to buy" because "sells size M" would be read as ambiguous and asked back. The box's witness opens cheapest first and may stop at the first that qualifies.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Is there any Ashcombe listing with size M available to buy for under $24? Answer yes or no, and name the seller if yes.

tasks.note: The same question with a limit no listing meets: no listing can sell size M under $23, and the cheapest that can charges $23.43. A no owes every listing advertised at or below $23, which the box's witness check holds it to.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Is there any Ashcombe listing with size M available to buy for under $23? Answer yes or no, and name the seller if yes.

tasks.note: The 3 cheapest that can sell size M, in order: Copperfield Outfitters at $23.43, Pentland Threads at $26.03, Haldane Textiles at $26.21. The next can sell it at $27.66, so the set is unique. Scored by the ranked kind: the sellers in that order, each with its price.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Which three sellers are cheapest for size M among listings that can actually supply it, and at what prices?

tasks.note: A comparison of two named listings that both sell size M. Copperfield Outfitters advertises $18.74 and charges $23.43 for M; Pentland Threads advertises $24.68 and charges $26.03. No two listings that can sell size M cross over on this market, so the pair is the two cheapest that can sell it and the results page points the right way; neither size-M price is on it. The ranked key requires Copperfield with its price; Pentland is optional, but if named with a price it must be its size-M price, so quoting its advertised price is wrong.
tasks.query: Go to {base}/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Between Copperfield Outfitters and Pentland Threads, which is cheaper for size M, and what is that price?

tasks.note: The cheapest-target question for size XL, which the fixture's crossover rule makes a different seller from size M. 13 of 15 listings offer XL and 10 can ship it.
